title: 通用病理与条件后果：RAG多跳可追溯性的三重稳健性分析
summary: 该研究对GraphRAG与向量RAG在多跳引用精度上的差异进行了三重稳健性分析，固定检索架构，变化嵌入器、语料库和评判器。发现过度引用是架构普遍的，但忠实性后果取决于语料库；单评判器LLM的忠实性评估脆弱。提出三重稳健性是可信RAG架构声明的最低标准。
summary_en: This study presents a triple-robustness analysis of GraphRAG vs vector RAG for multi-hop citation precision, varying embedder, corpus, and judge. Over-citation is architecturally universal, but faithfulness consequences are corpus-conditional. Single-judge LLM faithfulness is fragile. Triple-robustness is proposed as the minimum bar for trustworthy RAG claims.
